title: Expanding amide bond formation with CaLB-BOP: from sterically hindered substrates to aqueous and micellar media
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15290-15299
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00592F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Katarina Zlatić, Antonija Ožegović, Nikola Maraković, Anamarija Knežević
CaLB-BOP method enables efficient amide bond formation from non-activated esters and amines under mild conditions. It outperforms classical enzymatic aminolysis for sterically hindered substrates and operates effectively in water and micellar media.
